headlines.text: Flash back to 2023, when Andrade El Idolo vs. Bryan Danielson met in a Continental Classic League Match, topping the bill that night on Collision, rated 8.43 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. Just 24 hours after his grueling war with Garcia, a battered Danielson dug deep to outlast a fresh Andrade and keep his Continental Classic win streak alive.

It was 2022 when a new chapter began as Hikaru Shida vs. The Bunny fought for the brand-new Regina Di WAVE Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.20. Shida successfully defended her Regina di WAVE Championship against a returning Bunny, who'd spent six months rehabbing a neck injury before making her comeback.
Back on this day in 2020, MJF vs. Orange Cassidy met in a match with the Dynamite Diamond Ring on the line, serving as the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 6.76.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2022, when Trent Seven made a statement, debuting in the main event against Orange Cassidy, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.46.
Looking back to 2023, when Eddie Kingston vs. Claudio Castagnoli met in a Continental Classic League Match, setting the tone as the night's opener on Collision, rated 7.93 ? a solid showing.
On this day in 2022, Jon Moxley vs. Konosuke Takeshita delivered an outstanding performance from both sides on Rampage, rated 8.67.
